Dongying ZhaoRui Science & Trading Co., Ltd. is a dynamic and rapidly growing Chinese enterprise specializing in the research, development, production, and international trade of specialty chemical products. Established with a strong commitment to scientific innovation, quality excellence, and sustainable development, the company is strategically headquartered at No. 233 Zhenxinglu, Kenli County, Dongying City—within the heart of Shandong Province’s robust chemical industry cluster. Dongying’s advantageous location, coupled with its well-developed infrastructure, port access, and proximity to major petrochemical bases, enables ZhaoRui to efficiently serve both domestic and global markets.

The company focuses on high-value chemical intermediates, polymer additives, industrial catalysts, and environmentally conscious formulations tailored for sectors including plastics, coatings, agrochemicals, pharmaceuticals, and rubber processing. Complying rigorously with ISO 9001, ISO 14001, and OHSAS 18001 standards, ZhaoRui integrates advanced analytical laboratories, modern pilot-scale facilities, and a certified quality management system to ensure batch-to-batch consistency and regulatory compliance (including REACH, RoHS, and GB standards). Its R&D team—comprising experienced chemists and materials scientists—collaborates closely with universities and research institutes to drive product innovation and customized technical solutions. With a growing export footprint across Southeast Asia, the Middle East, Africa, and Latin America, ZhaoRui combines technical expertise with responsive customer support and agile supply chain management. As it advances toward its vision of becoming a trusted global partner in specialty chemicals, Dongying ZhaoRui Science & Trading Co., Ltd. remains steadfast in its core values: integrity, science-driven progress, environmental stewardship, and collaborative growth.
